tags.name: Tense

tags.name: Deep

tags.name: Energetic

tags.name: Minimal

tags.name: Slow
tags.description: Slow-paced, calm, or carried by a restrained flow.

tags.description: Deliberately evokes older music, synth, game, or production aesthetics.

tags.name: Chill
tags.description: Relaxed and suitable for unwinding or casual background listening.

tags.name: Sleep

tags.description: Combines multiple songs or musical elements into one track.

tags.description: A deliberately slowed-down version of a track.
